title: Pension schemes newsletter 186 — October 2026
text:
This newsletter is published by HMRC’s Pension Schemes Services to update stakeholders on the latest news for pension schemes.

 Pension schemes newsletter 186 has articles on: 

 • Budget and Finance Bill 2026 

 • Surplus Extraction Tax Regime  

 • access to pensions for the terminally ill 

 • lifetime allowance abolition — tax on excess pension lump sum death benefits 

 • tax treatment of pension death benefits under the two-year rule

 • Guided Retirement and Retirement Collective Money Purchase pension schemes 

 • Inheritance Tax on Pensions — minor technical amendments to the extension of IHT to pensions from April 2027 

 • Inheritance Tax on Pensions — Technical Note 2 

 • the delay of the digitalisation of relief at source (DigiRAS) Strategic Payments Service until 2027 

 • a new online tool to help customers claim pension tax refunds 

 • contacting HMRC about pensions tax and pension scheme matters 

 • pension flexibility statistics 

 • registration statistics
